directories.why: Project virtualenv. Rebuilt exactly from the committed uv.lock, so nothing in it is unique to this machine.
uv's package cache (cache-dir is set to .uv-cache in pyproject.toml). Pure download cache; re-fills on the next sync.
CPython bytecode caches. Regenerated automatically the next time a module is imported.
Ruff's incremental lint cache. Only affects lint speed; ruff rewrites it on the next run.
Pytest's last-failed / node-id cache. Holds no results, only run bookkeeping.
Coverage HTML report. pyproject's pytest addopts already pass --cov-report=html, so a normal test run recreates it.
